title: CAP oral step-down flips with hemodynamic instability
task: As of the decision date, decide whether community-acquired pneumonia therapy can step down from IV to oral antibiotics, requiring hemodynamic stability and improving oxygenation.

record.text: Community-acquired pneumonia clinically improving after IV ceftriaxone and azithromycin.
Afebrile, blood pressure stable, oxygen saturation 96 percent on room air, tolerating oral intake.
Community-acquired pneumonia receiving IV ceftriaxone and azithromycin.
Hypotension requiring vasopressors and oxygen saturation 88 percent on high-flow oxygen.

clinical_rationale: Hemodynamic stability is the decisive controlled change for oral step-down.
